page_title: BookWitch: Write Your Novel, Export EPUB & PDF for Amazon KDP

sources.entry: Book Witch - Use the power of AI to create complete e-books with just one click! #freemium

summary.name: BookWitch
summary.one_liner: BookWitch is an AI novel-writing studio that keeps a story bible of your characters, places and plot, and exports the finished book as an EPUB and a print-ready paperback PDF for Amazon KDP.
use_cases: Writing a long novel while keeping characters and world consistent
Drafting the next scene with a keyboard shortcut
Formatting a finished manuscript for Amazon KDP
Exporting a novel as EPUB and paperback PDF
Tightening or expanding highlighted prose in a chosen tone
summary.what_it_does: BookWitch stores a story bible of characters, locations, factions and objects, and the AI uses these entries when generating text. Names link automatically as you type, and hovering over an entity shows its sheet. Highlighting a sentence lets you tighten, expand or change its tone, and the ⌘K shortcut drafts the next scene. Each AI suggestion appears as a diff that you can accept or reject. When the manuscript is finished, the tool builds an EPUB and a print-ready paperback PDF formatted for Amazon KDP. The page says it writes explicit romance and dark themes without refusing or lecturing.
notable: Story bible the AI reads on every generation, so characters and plot stay consistent
Suggestions appear as diffs you accept or reject, keeping the author in control
Exports EPUB and print-ready paperback PDF formatted for Amazon KDP
Permits explicit romance and dark fiction content
caveats: The page names a 'Start free' call to action, but paid tier details are not stated
Listing describes it as freemium; the page itself does not list prices
Page is largely marketing copy; features beyond those listed are not described
